facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.build_bleu_scorer: build a Scorer instance with BleuConfig to compute BLEU scores from torch.IntTensor references and predictions

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.compute_bleu_score: compute the final BLEU score by calling score on the Scorer with a specified n-gram order
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.create_sacrebleu_scorer: create a SacrebleuScorer with SacrebleuConfig to evaluate translations using sacrebleu corpus_bleu with custom tokenization
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.get_bleu_result_string: get a formatted BLEU result string with precision, brevity penalty, ratio, and lengths via result_string

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.create_chrf_scorer: create a ChrFScorer instance to compute character n-gram F-score for translation evaluation
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.add_string_ref_pred: add a reference and prediction string pair to the ChrFScorer for scoring
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.score_chrf: score accumulated reference and prediction pairs using character n-gram F-score with order 4
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.result_string_chrf: get the formatted chrF result object from sacrebleu corpus_chrf for the scorer
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.review_chrf_scorer_class: review the ChrFScorer class that extends BaseScorer and uses sacrebleu for chrF scoring

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.create_evaluation_tokenizer: create an EvaluationTokenizer with sacreBLEU tokenizer type 13a for evaluation-time text tokenization
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.tokenize_sentence: tokenize a sentence using the EvaluationTokenizer with optional lowercasing and punctuation removal
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.remove_punctuation_classmethod: remove punctuation from a sentence using the EvaluationTokenizer remove_punctuation class method based on Unicode category
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.create_character_tokenizer: create an EvaluationTokenizer with character tokenization enabled to split text into individual characters
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.review_tokenizer_types: review the EvaluationTokenizer ALL_TOKENIZER_TYPES enum to see available sacreBLEU tokenizer options like none, 13a, intl, zh, ja-mecab

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.create_WerScorerConfig: create a WerScorerConfig dataclass to configure WER evaluation with tokenizer, punctuation removal, and character level options
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.build_WerScorer: build a WerScorer instance that computes word error rate using editdistance and an EvaluationTokenizer
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.run_add_string: run add_string on a WerScorer to accumulate edit distance between reference and hypothesis strings
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.test_score: test the WerScorer score method to return the WER percentage from accumulated edit distance and reference length
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/fairse.review_reset: review the WerScorer reset method to zero out accumulated distance and reference length counters
